author: Hermes
question: Find the next term: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
solution: Successive differences are 4, 6, 8, 10 (increasing by 2), so the next difference is 12 and the next term is 30 + 12 = 42. Series reasoning is part of aptitude sections across these exams. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/question_paper_pattern
subject: General Aptitude
